task_definition.task_description: I need you to check the flight status for flight AA100. Then, get the weather alert card for Los Angeles LAX and publish it to Alice on the app with high priority. Next, look up the hotel information for the Hilton Tokyo, build a booking request, and book a deluxe room for John Doe from May 10 to May 15, 2026. After that, find trending travel recommendations for Alice based on product p_sony_xm5_blk, sort the items in descending order, stringify the data, and send it to Alice in an instant message. Finally, create a snapshot of the '/user/travel_planning' workspace and save the backup as 'travel_backup'.
